entry_points.text: Proc operations bind open release iterated read seek and mmap; fault handling has two builds with cached read versus bus error; mmap rejects oversize and writable or executable requests adjusts flags and installs fault operations before mapping.
Each mount view opens through a dedicated selector into shared capture logic; nommu mapping preparation accepts only shared semantics records access and associates generic virtual operations.

Seek entries validate descriptors and width before delegating with overflow and user copy handling; positional read and write entries reject negative offsets require capability and delegate with explicit offset.

exports.text: Vmcore exposes callback unregister with drain, old memory read with zero fill for non RAM, weak arch defaults for header and remap handling for platform override, device dump registration, and full teardown.

Mount views expose three operation vectors sharing sequential read splice seek and release with poll on two; ramfs exposes paged and nonpaged file vectors with inode attribute handling plus mapping area selection capability query and expand preparation.
Ramfs creates typed inodes with ownership timestamps and storage operations, and provides context setup with default mode, anonymous super teardown, type registration and module init.
Generic layer offers constrained seeks, write dispatch with mode range and count checks using legacy or iterator path plus modify notice, and stream aware offset snapshot with commit on success.

hazards.text: Short copies transfers and mapping helper failures surface as faults; table alloc counter permission and mapping failures surface distinctly with partial mmap rollback and one time warnings for misaligned ranges and late additions; disabled dumps are rejected.

Malformed headers missing fields disabled state and allocation failures yield invalid argument or no memory with busy refusal when adding while open; missing task namespace or root yields invalid or not found; outside root mountpoints skip lines so readers tolerate gaps.

Size may run ahead of backing store on allocation failure with high order splits freed and only unattached pages released on insert failure; area lookup fails without contiguity; narrow seeks may overflow; data and hole fail at size; vectored loops allow partial success. Interop uses ELF widths types and note layouts with page granularity, mount flag spellings, octal default mode and half word position compose.
Parsing display allocation list locking task security and accounting rely on external helpers owned elsewhere and folded here per pass rule.

invariants.text: Total size sums header notes and ranges; range offsets run contiguously after header plus notes; loads expand to page bounds preserving intra page offset; refresh reassigns sequentially; header store is page rounded and never shrinks; count overflow is refused.

Crash headers require matching magic core type arch class version sizes and nonzero count; top level checks identification then dispatches by width; init allocates arch storage parses releases temp and creates owner read entry; cleanup removes entry and frees state.

Notes coalesce to a single entry with compacted table page rounding and remembered payload; per note size walks records to terminator with capacity warnings; copy skips non notes; dump headers carry name and payload lengths; one build hook does nothing; allocation prefers mappable store when available.

Pages default to RAM consulting a callback list with optional classifiers stopping at first negative; negative pages read as zeros and map to zero page preserving contiguity; dump prefix precedes notes.

Mount poll stays readable and signals generation change once; option display maps super and mount flags to spellings plus security hook; three views share escaped names but differ in line shape; open pins task namespace and root and seeds generation; release drops references.

Ramfs mount holds mode with default and forward declared tables; super sets large size page blocks magic and root; unknown params ignored except masked mode; nommu resize delegates zero growth and validates shrink; setattr splits size and attrs; area lookup needs contiguity; paged passes through; nommu advertises direct copy with full perms.

Entry creation shares allocation security dentry persist and timestamp refresh with type specific links sizes and open finish; vectored paths check mode import vectors verify range and use iterator or legacy loop; split positions combine half word halves.

locks.text: Global mutex serializes callback mutation sticky opened flag count and device dump commit drain; sleepable guard protects classifier traversal with grace wait after unregister.
Mount view capture holds target task protection while acquiring namespace and root references.
Generic seek holds killable inode lock across size and position update; write paths hold freeze protection across dispatch including errors.

state_machines.text: Vmcore open sets sticky flag and counts refs rejecting wrap; images order header dump prefixed notes then ranges with bounded fill and rollback on map failure; bringup runs alloc parse coalesce register to size publish with release on fail; dump add checks disabled and args allocs fills then commits guarded warning if late refusing if open.

Seek implements set current end data and hole with size resolution and negative rejection unless unsigned allowed; vectored wrappers snapshot position delegate commit on success and apply accounting with positional variants validating offsets and capability.

structs.text: Range nodes carry start length offset and linkage for size and translation; dump nodes carry buffer length and linkage consumed as a concatenated stream.
Option entries pair mask with spelling; mount and ramfs tables use standard operation layouts with optional poll, area or capability hooks, and paired attribute set and get.

Mount config holds mode in filesystem info; directory inode behavior pairs ramfs creation handlers with shared simple helpers; read only generic files offer lease seek splice read and mapping preparation.
